mapper.sql: p.id, p.reserva_id AS reservaId, p.monto, p.metodo_pago AS metodoPago, p.estado_pago AS estadoPago, p.referencia_transaccion AS referenciaTransaccion, p.fecha_pago AS fechaPago, p.comprobante_url AS comprobanteUrl, p.modalidad_pago AS modalidadPago, p.intencion_id AS intencionId, p.monto_original AS montoOriginal, p.descuento_total AS descuentoTotal, p.estado_sync AS estadoSync, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt, p.deleted, p.version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pago (reserva_id, monto, metodo_pago, estado_pago, referencia_transaccion, fecha_pago, comprobante_url, modalidad_pago, intencion_id, monto_original, descuento_total, estado_sync) VALUES (#{reservaId}, #{monto}, #{metodoPago}, #{estadoPago}, #{referenciaTransaccion}, #{fechaPago}, #{comprobanteUrl}, #{modalidadPago}, #{intencionId}, #{montoOriginal}, #{descuentoTotal}, #{estadoSync})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = FALSE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pago p WHERE p.reserva_id = #{reservaId} AND p.deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE pago SET estado_pago = #{estadoPago}, estado_sync = #{estadoSync}, referencia_transaccion = #{referenciaTransaccion}, intencion_id = #{intencionId}, fecha_pago = #{fechaPago}, metodo_pago = #{metodoPago}, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
